news.headline: MAJOR FLOODING CONTINUES SAT PM — NWS Melbourne (3:01 PM Sat): River Flood Warnings remain in effect for Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford on the St. Johns River — all five points are in Major Flood Stage or forecast to reach it; Cocoa was at 18.8 ft Sat morning (flood stage 16.0 ft), Geneva at 12.2 ft forecast to crest at 13.0 ft Sun afternoon, Astor steady at 4.0 ft; scattered showers and isolated storms today could aggravate saturated, flooded areas, with gusty winds 45-55 mph and small hail possible in the strongest storms; Orlando high 76°F

Minto sells 18-acre Westlake parcel to Eastwind for the city's first apartments — The Avery at Westlake, a 360-unit community in eight garden-style buildings, closed Nov 19; the Westlake City Council approved the site plan Aug 4

Florida home sales slowed in October — Florida Realtors (released Nov 16): single-family closed sales 19,049, down 10.1% year over year, median price $420,000 up 2.2%; condo-townhouse sales 6,862, down 5%, median $290,000 down 3.3%; new pending single-family sales down 15.7%

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition
Copper stays in selloff Sat — latest quote $5.49/lb on Nov 21 (1:06 PM EST), down 2.64%; COMEX copper last closed Fri Nov 20 at $5.4770/lb

MasTec to acquire Murphy Corporation for about $1.25 billion in cash — Murphy, a large mechanical contractor with HVAC, plumbing and process work for mission-critical markets, is projected to generate about $775 million in 2026 revenue and about $140 million in Adjusted EBITDA, with about 1,600 employees including about 1,200 union craft professionals

Markets plunge for the week — on Fri Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33; for the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, the Nasdaq 10% and the Dow 8%, the worst week since April 2025

Mortgage rates ease Sat — Zillow data via Yahoo Finance put the 30-year fixed purchase rate at 7.18% on Sat Nov 21, down 15 basis points from Friday, with the 15-year fixed at 6.57%; Mortgage News Daily put the 30-year at 7.33% on Fri Nov 20, its lowest since Nov 10
news.source: Zillow via Yahoo Finance / Mortgage News Daily
